comment: Android emulator controller and its read-only check task, applied on top of interface.json by scripts/android_interface.py for the Android development home (scripts/android_dev_home.py). No package uses it yet (phase F); the Windows package copies interface.json unchanged. Input is Maatouch only and capture RawByNetcat only (docs/android-support-plan.md decision 5); the client applies these instead of the device discovery's masks (phase B5b).

controller.name: nikki_android
controller.label: 无限暖暖（安卓模拟器，开发中）
controller.description: 连接安卓模拟器里的无限暖暖。开发中：目前只开放只读的「安卓检查」，不向游戏发送任何输入。

task.name: android_check
task.label: 安卓检查（只读）
task.description: 确认游戏在模拟器前台后截一张图，报告认出的画面和各个动作此刻会点哪里；只截图和识别，不向游戏发送任何输入。
